### Authoritative Standard / RFC Reference

All cryptographic and security primitives must be backed by authoritative, peer-reviewed standards. Please provide references:
- [ ] NIST Special Publication (e.g. SP 800-38D, SP 800-63B, SP 800-162, FIPS 203)
- [ ] IETF RFC (e.g. RFC 8439, RFC 6238, RFC 4226)
- [ ] W3C / FIDO Alliance Standard (e.g. WebAuthn Level 3, MDS3)
- [ ] OWASP Guidance
- Specific reference link / standard section:

### Native AOT & Memory Allocation Impact

- Will this capability require reflection, runtime code generation, or heavy unmanaged dependencies?
- How will this feature maintain zero-allocation or span-based throughput invariants?

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
